findings.claim: The publication manifest binds rules_sha256 to real-log-rules.json, but for 2026 the session start, official round, supported software, and operator authorization markers are hardcoded in operational_review.py rather than in the rules file, decoupling execution from the recorded hash.
findings.failure_scenario: A maintainer alters TEMPLATES_2026 in operational_review.py (e.g. changing the operator authorization regex or software name). When semantic-pass run executes, _rules_sha(2026) hashes real-log-rules.json, which does not contain TEMPLATES_2026, and produces the unchanged hash. Downstream verifiers comparing rules_sha256 cannot detect that operational session and authorization rules were altered.
findings.falsification: Verify that templates is absent from election_audit/resources/real-log-rules.json, and check whether changing TEMPLATES_2026 in operational_review.py alters _rules_sha(2026).
findings.title: 2026 operational templates hardcoded in Python decouple execution from rules_sha256 publication binding

summary: Review of Campaign xr1-20261109 Round R1 Packet P2 (parsing and log semantics). Conducted adversarial audit of archive_parsing.py, reconstruction.py, operational_review.py, semantic_pass.py, sa_logs.py, round1_prefix.py, and real-log-rules*.json. Identified 6 findings: (1) state leakage in semantic_pass and operational_review where orphan completions fail to clear pending cycle state, corrupting subsequent voter authorization methods; (2) strict calendar-day enforcement dropping in-flight and subsequent vote cycles across midnight rollover; (3) exact software version string matching causing official sessions to silently drop 100% of vote cycles without error on variant builds; (4) 2026 operational templates hardcoded in Python code rather than in real-log-rules.json, decoupling execution from the published rules_sha256 binding; (5) copy_candidate stream fingerprint equality failing to detect truncated memory copies ending at different line counts; and (6) unmapped VOTA session start messages failing to close official sessions, allowing training votes to be tallied as official votes.
